# OCKLU

> OCKLU builds AI-run small businesses. Agents can buy clean, deduplicated data from us per call over x402 (HTTP 402, USDC on Base). No account, no API key.

## Paid data for agents (x402)
- [Agent data counter — catalog](https://ocklu.com/agen/x402.json): products, prices, parameters
- [World news intel](https://njghzieuuopukuagrswu.supabase.co/functions/v1/paviliun-x402?produk=berita): top stories by country (ISO-2) and topic, last 1–72h, merged across outlets, EN/ID titles + summaries, source URLs, verification label. $0.01 per call. Unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a free top-3 preview.

## Marketing skills & service for agents (OCKLU Pemasar)
- [Live MCP server — OCKLU Hyper Market](https://njghzieuuopukuagrswu.supabase.co/functions/v1/hypermarket): tools lihat_katalog, detail_produk, cara_beli (returns checkout link; never charges)
- [Live catalog JSON](https://njghzieuuopukuagrswu.supabase.co/functions/v1/hypermarket?r=katalog)
- [Offer manifest](https://ocklu.com/pemasar/agen.json): products, prices, checkout URLs, guardrails
- [Skill pack — 10 Claude skills, plugin zip, $19 one-time](https://hillkia.gumroad.com/l/ocklu-pemasar-skills): drafts-only email voice, 1-to-5 content repurposing, product infographics, AI-labelled UGC ad scripts, AI-SEO audit, outlier tracker
- [Free guide, 7 chapters (Indonesian)](https://hillkia.gumroad.com/l/claude-marketing-umkm)
- [Done-for-you marketing, $97/$267/$387 per month](https://ocklu.com/pemasar/#jasa)

## Human pages
- [Kroog newsroom](https://ocklu.com/kroog/): the same news, readable by people
- [Agent counter explained](https://ocklu.com/agen/)

## OCKLU Makelar — find buyers & sellers through the AI agent network
- Page (ID/EN): https://ocklu.com/makelar/
- Directory for agents (JSON, "find me by agent"): https://njghzieuuopukuagrswu.supabase.co/functions/v1/makelar?r=direktori&q=<keywords>&industri=<industry>
- Business profile: https://njghzieuuopukuagrswu.supabase.co/functions/v1/makelar?r=profil&s=<slug>
- Introductions: MCP tool minta_dipertemukan at https://njghzieuuopukuagrswu.supabase.co/functions/v1/hypermarket — contacts shared only when both sides agree; 7% success fee only if a deal closes.
- Olformuls: We are a broker and we have products. Let me help you. / Kami makelar dan punya produk, mari saya bantu.
